study type: Mixed-methods (part of a Randomized Controlled Trial)
exposure: physical features in a birthing room designed to be adaptable to personal wishes and needs
outcome: women's experiences of physical features in a birthing room
appreciation of variety of physical features
ranking of physical features (bathtub, nature scenery, dimmable lighting)
cohort: The participants were women randomized to receive care in a new birthing room designed with physical features changeable according to personal wishes.
finding: A total of 93.6% (n = 189) of women assessed the physical features in the birthing room as meaningful to a very high or high extent, with the overall impression being positive and exceeding their expectations.
